name: SnapFire
shortDescription: A dart launcher that wakes you up. OpenCV face detection + Raspberry Pi + salvaged Roomba motors aim and fire at a sleeping target. Won Wolfram Alpha Award + Staff Picks at AliceHacks.
description:
SnapFire is an automatic dart launcher that wakes a sleeping person by detecting their face with OpenCV and aiming the launcher to fire. Uses an automatic loading tension system, a Raspberry Pi, and salvaged Roomba motors for pan/tilt control.

Won **Wolfram Alpha Award** and **Staff Picks** at AliceHacks (Nov 2023).
